jobs.title: Head of Marketing
jobs.description:
This employer is seeking a strategic leader to oversee marketing operations, data analytics, and performance measurement for a growing technology company. The role involves managing the marketing tech stack, defining attribution models, and partnering closely with revenue and finance teams to drive pipeline growth.

The Role

• Lead and manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics functions while scaling the team and technology stack
• Own end-to-end attribution methodology, measurement, and reporting of marketing's pipeline contribution to executive leadership
• Oversee core marketing systems, data hygiene, lead lifecycle management, and account-based marketing infrastructure
• Manage the marketing technology budget, capacity modeling, and planning processes in alignment with sales and finance objectives

What You'll Need

• 10+ years of experience in marketing operations or analytics within B2B or enterprise software environments
• Proven track record of managing teams, marketing tech stacks, and multi-touch attribution models
• Hands-on expertise configuring and managing enterprise automation platforms and CRM systems like Marketo and Salesforce
• Proficiency in SQL and business intelligence tools for data validation and executive reporting

What's On Offer

• Competitive salary
• Comprehensive health and dental benefits, including mental health support
• Generous paid time off and retirement savings plan matching
• Professional development stipends and flexible work arrangements

jobs.title: Senior Director, Development and Construction Accounting (Vancouver, BC)
jobs.description:
As Senior Director, Development and Construction Accounting, you'll lead a team of Managers and own the financial results, reporting, and controls for a portfolio of development and construction projects. You'll also stay hands-on, supporting and guiding Development Accountants across your teams.

Working closely with project teams, senior leadership, and Anthem Partners, you'll make sure project financials are accurate and clearly communicated. We're looking for someone pragmatic and persistent, who thrives in a fast-paced environment and keeps solving problems until they're solved.

You are

A proven senior leader who is agile, adaptable and results-oriented
Friendly and approachable, with the ability to build strong relationships across the accounting, project and senior leadership teams
Proactive and independent, with strong, open communication
Accurate, organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, modern ERP environment

You will

Lead, mentor and develop a team of Managers reporting directly into you through regular meetings and defined growth plans
Take direct responsibility for supporting the Development Accountants, working alongside their Managers to provide technical guidance, ensuring quality and timely work and fostering growth and development
Own the financial close for the portfolio, ensuring compliance with internal controls and company policies
Maintain thorough knowledge of all projects in the portfolio, working with project teams so proformas are accurate and financial impacts are clearly communicated to senior leadership and partners
Oversee project proformas, scenario modelling and cash flow projections, with a strong understanding of capital structuring
Analyze portfolio performance to identify risks and opportunities early, and proactively raise issues with project teams and senior leadership
Oversee partner and financial reporting, ensuring accuracy, consistency with deal structures and timely delivery
Ensure compliance with partnership and management agreements
Oversee construction loan draws and relationships with cost consultants and lenders
Own the audit program for the project portfolio, coordinating multiple audits and reviewing audit support
Drive process improvement and stronger internal controls across the accounting team
Act as a steward of Anthem's culture, cultivating a collaborative, diverse and inclusive team environment, in the spirit of The Anthem Way

You have

10+ years of progressive real estate development accounting experience, including leading and developing managers and multi-level teams
A CPA designation
Real estate development accounting expertise, including financial modelling, cash management and financial reporting
Advanced Excel skills; Yardi experience preferred
Proven ability to handle high volume in a fast-paced environment with multiple competing demands
Exceptional oral and written communication skills, including presenting project information to all levels of Anthem management and partners

We have

Great, diverse, authentic people!
Unlimited career growth opportunities
Mentorship from the 'best in the biz'
Corporate Giving Strategy supporting community development
Annual salary reviews and performance bonuses
100% employer paid Benefit Plan with Healthcare Spending Account and Employee Assistance Program
Educational Assistance Program
'Dress for your day' policy... and more!

Salary range: $175,000 - $200,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications

Founded in 1991, Anthem is a team of 850+ people driven by creativity, passion and direct communication. Anthem has invested in, developed or managed – alone or in partnership – more than 400 residential and commercial projects across North America.

Our growing residential portfolio includes 44,000 homes that are complete, in design or under construction, from mixed-use residential to townhome, rental and single-family homes. We own, co-own, manage or have previously owned 12 million square feet of retail, industrial and office space, and our land portfolio includes more than 60 communities, spanning 9,100 acres across Canada and the United States.

Anthem is a real estate development, investment and management company that strives, solves and evolves to create better spaces and stronger communities. We are Growing Places.

Please, no unsolicited resumes or phone inquiries from agencies. View our Policy on Unsolicited Resumes on our website.
